meta.title: Synthetic Rainbow Tail Disease (RTD) Dataset
meta.description: Entirely fictional disease and figures generated for prototyping the IDM dashboard. Structure mirrors the idm-report.schema.json shape but contains no real APHA/IDM report data.
meta.disclaimer: Rainbow Tail Disease (RTD) does not exist. All countries, strains, counts and narrative text in this file are synthetic and generated purely for UI/prototype purposes. Do not use for anything other than dashboard development.

months.narrative: Low for livestock incursion – no change. In July, in Europe, there were reports of Rainbow Tail Disease (RTD) Variant A in France (2 outbreaks, 3 cases), Germany (1 outbreak, 2 cases), the Netherlands (4 cases) and Spain (3 cases). No further changes were noted this month. (Synthetic illustrative data only.)
